build_LDHead: build a Localization Distillation Head for object detection with teacher-student knowledge transfer
review_LDHead_loss_by_feat_single: review the LDHead loss_by_feat_single method to calculate single scale level loss with soft targets
test_LDHead_loss: test the LDHead loss method to compute detection losses using teacher model soft targets
refactor_LDHead_loss_ld: refactor the LDHead localization distillation loss to support custom temperature and weight parameters
summarize_LDHead_loss_by_feat: summarize the LDHead loss_by_feat method that computes multi-scale classification, bbox, dfl, and ld losses
